purpose: Prospective forward-testing boundary, established BEFORE any post-boundary outcome is observed. Genuine intraday Bar Replay was re-confirmed unavailable at declaration time (see docs/PINE_P8.md Section 3) -- Daily-only replay is NOT used as a substitute for 5m/15m/30m evidence, per the explicit P8 instruction against fake replay.
p8_boundary_local: declared in UTC only; no local-timezone offset applies to this environment's session
eligibility_rule: A signal qualifies as a P8 forward observation on timeframe TF if and only if its SIGNAL_BAR_TIME (unix ms from the frozen contract's SIGNAL_BAR_TIME field, converted to unix seconds) is STRICTLY GREATER than boundary_chart_bar_time[TF].last_confirmed_bar_time_unix. Any signal at or before this value is historical (already reflected in P6/P7 development statistics) and is EXCLUDED from the P8 forward ledger, with no exception.
boundary_immutability_statement: This boundary was written before observing any post-boundary outcome and must never be moved, regardless of how many or how few qualifying signals accumulate, and regardless of whether early forward results are favorable or unfavorable.
